question: What’s the nearest hotel encountered heading toward MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center, Rosedale, Maryland from Rock of the Marne, VA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.073797 38.876769)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.478714 39.351819)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.073797 38.876769)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.073797 38.876769)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center, Rosedale, Maryland
